title: $34,200 wedding or a house down payment?

scenes.text: The average American wedding now costs $34,200. That's one day... or a down payment on a home. Which would you pick?
The average guest list is 117 people. That's $292 per guest. The venue alone: $12,900. For a 6-hour party, about $5,700 an hour.
Mike goes all in: $34,200. Jake has a $10,000 wedding. And a quarter of couples spend $12,000 or less.
Jake invests the $24,200 difference. In 30 years at 7%, that's about $184,000.
So spend on the marriage, not just the wedding.
Big wedding or small wedding? Fight it out in the comments.

props.disclaimer: Avg cost: The Knot 2026 Real Weddings Study. Investing example assumes ~7%/yr, not guaranteed. Not financial advice.
